name: What is the process for starting a low-maintenance landscaping project with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a low-maintenance landscaping project with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting your low-maintenance landscaping project with Simply Construction begins with an initial consultation. During this meeting, we discuss your vision, budget, and specific needs. Our design team then develops a customized plan incorporating suitable low-maintenance elements like xeriscaping, artificial turf, or hardscaping. Once the design is approved, we provide a detailed proposal and timeline. Our experienced team handles all aspects of the installation, from site preparation to final touches, ensuring a smooth and efficient process tailored to your Southern Nevada property.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with a consultation to discuss your vision and budget. We then create a custom design, provide a proposal, and our team manages the full installation.
